description: This file implements a debug wrapper around the 'ref_store' component in a Git-related codebase, adding tracing for various reference store operations.

classes.name: debug_ref_store
classes.description: A wrapper around ref_store for debugging, includes a reference to the actual ref_store.

classes.name: debug_ref_iterator
classes.description: Extends ref_iterator to include debug trace functionality.

methods.name: struct:ref_store * maybe_debug_wrap_ref_store(const char * gitdir,struct ref_store * store)
methods.description: Wraps a ref_store with debugging capabilities, adding tracing if enabled.

methods.name: void debug_release(struct ref_store * refs)
methods.description: Releases the wrapped ref_store, with tracing.

methods.name: int debug_create_on_disk(struct ref_store * refs,int flags,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Creates ref store on disk with debug tracing.

methods.name: int debug_remove_on_disk(struct ref_store * refs,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Removes ref store on disk with debug tracing.

methods.name: int debug_transaction_prepare(struct ref_store * refs,struct ref_transaction * transaction,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Prepares a transaction with debug tracing.

methods.name: void print_update(int i,const char * refname,const struct object_id * old_oid,const struct object_id * new_oid,unsigned int flags,unsigned int type,const char * msg)
methods.description: Prints detailed information about a ref update for debugging.

methods.name: void print_transaction(struct ref_transaction * transaction)
methods.description: Prints the details of a transaction for debugging.

methods.name: int debug_transaction_finish(struct ref_store * refs,struct ref_transaction * transaction,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Completes a transaction with tracing.

methods.name: int debug_transaction_abort(struct ref_store * refs,struct ref_transaction * transaction,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Aborts a transaction with tracing.

methods.name: int debug_optimize(struct ref_store * ref_store,struct refs_optimize_opts * opts)
methods.description: Runs optimization with debug tracing.

methods.name: int debug_optimize_required(struct ref_store * ref_store,struct refs_optimize_opts * opts,bool * required)
methods.description: Checks if optimization is required, with tracing.

methods.name: int debug_rename_ref(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * oldref,const char * newref,const char * logmsg)
methods.description: Renames a reference with tracing.

methods.name: int debug_copy_ref(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * oldref,const char * newref,const char * logmsg)
methods.description: Copies a reference with tracing.

methods.name: int debug_ref_iterator_advance(struct ref_iterator * ref_iterator)
methods.description: Advances the ref iterator with tracing.

methods.name: int debug_ref_iterator_seek(struct ref_iterator * ref_iterator,const char * refname,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Seeks the ref iterator with tracing.

methods.name: void debug_ref_iterator_release(struct ref_iterator * ref_iterator)
methods.description: Releases the ref iterator with tracing.

methods.name: struct:ref_iterator * debug_ref_iterator_begin(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * prefix,const char ** exclude_patterns,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Begins a new ref iterator with tracing.

methods.name: int debug_read_raw_ref(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * refname,struct object_id * oid,struct strbuf * referent,unsigned int * type,int * failure_errno)
methods.description: Reads raw ref with debugging logs.

methods.name: int debug_read_symbolic_ref(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * refname,struct strbuf * referent)
methods.description: Reads a symbolic ref with debug logs.

methods.name: struct:ref_iterator * debug_reflog_iterator_begin(struct ref_store * ref_store)
methods.description: Begins reflog iteration with tracing.

methods.name: int debug_print_reflog_ent(const char * refname,struct object_id * old_oid,struct object_id * new_oid,const char * committer,timestamp_t timestamp,int tz,const char * msg,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Prints reflog entry for debugging.

methods.name: int debug_for_each_reflog_ent(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * refname,each_reflog_ent_fn fn,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Iterates through reflog entries with debug logging.

methods.name: int debug_for_each_reflog_ent_reverse(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * refname,each_reflog_ent_fn fn,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Iterates through reflog entries in reverse with logging.

methods.name: int debug_reflog_exists(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * refname)
methods.description: Checks existence of reflog with tracing.

methods.name: int debug_create_reflog(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * refname,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Creates reflog with debug tracing.

methods.name: int debug_delete_reflog(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * refname)
methods.description: Deletes reflog with trace logs.

methods.name: void debug_reflog_expiry_prepare(const char * refname,const struct object_id * oid,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Prepares reflog expiry with debug trace.

methods.name: int debug_reflog_expiry_should_prune_fn(struct object_id * ooid,struct object_id * noid,const char * email,timestamp_t timestamp,int tz,const char * message,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Determines if reflog entry should be pruned, with debug logs.

methods.name: void debug_reflog_expiry_cleanup(void * cb_data)
methods.description: Cleans up reflog expiry context with tracing.

methods.name: int debug_reflog_expire(struct ref_store * ref_store,const char * refname,unsigned int flags,reflog_expiry_prepare_fn prepare_fn,reflog_expiry_should_prune_fn should_prune_fn,reflog_expiry_cleanup_fn cleanup_fn,void * policy_cb_data)
methods.description: Expires reflog entries with debug tracing.

methods.name: int debug_fsck(struct ref_store * ref_store,struct fsck_options * o,struct worktree * wt)
methods.description: Performs filesystem consistency check with trace logs.
